paper_title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
reference_raw: Devlin, J., Chang, M. W., Lee, K., & Toutanova, K. (2018). BERT: Pre-training of deep bidirectional transformers for language understanding. arXiv preprint arXiv:1810.04805.
claim_text: BERT eliminates all transformer encoders and achieves state-of-the-art results using unidirectional recurrent LSTM units.
ground_truth_excerpt: BERT is designed to pretrain deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers.

paper_title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
reference_raw: He, K., Zhang, X., Ren, S., & Sun, J. (2016). Deep residual learning for image recognition. Proceedings of the IEEE conference on computer vision and pattern recognition, 770-778.
claim_text: Residual networks make it easier to optimize deep networks by learning residual mapping functions with reference to layer inputs.
ground_truth_excerpt: We explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping. Formally, denoting the desired underlying mapping as H(x), we let the stacked nonlinear layers fit another mapping of F(x) := H(x) - x.
